sources.summary: She won the battle but can there ever be peace in House of the Dragon? Plus, it’s Kim Kardashian’s turn in Secrets of the Celebrity Sex Tapes. Here’s what to watch this evening 9pm, Sky Atlantic With the thunderous warships v dragons Battle of the Gullet and its smouldering aftermath, season three of the Game of Thrones prequel has rapidly chalked up an impressive butcher’s bill of main cast casualties (plus hundreds of barbecued bystanders). Having sacrificed so much to claim the Iron Throne, Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D’Arcy) must now figure out what sort of ruler she wants to be at a time of kingdom-wide unrest.
